what: LONG-TAIL BATCH F, STEP 3 — an ability may SCALE a status chip, not only refuse it or convert it. Heatproof's burn is half size.
written: 2026-09-06, BEFORE the measuring run, by ENGINE.
the_rule: data/abilities.ts:1838-1841 — heatproof.onDamage returns `damage / 2` when `effect.id === 'brn'`. The burn is `this.damage(pokemon.baseMaxhp / 16)` at onResidualOrder 10 (data/conditions.ts:15-18, not overridden by the Champions mod), and spreadDamage clamps with clampIntRange(.,1) on BOTH sides of the Damage event, so a 146-HP body takes max(1,floor(146/16))=9 and then max(1,floor(9/2))=4.
new_tag: scalesOwnStatusDamage, derived in engine/tag_dex.js from the onDamage handler. MEMBERSHIP PRINTED BEFORE WIRING and it is ONE: heatproof, statuses ['brn'], mult 0.5. Every legal ability carrying an onDamage at all was listed first; the two that `return false` are refusesIndirectDamage and healsFromOwnStatus and are excluded explicitly, the four that answer a MOVE name no status, and Rock Head answers `recoil`.
probe: tests/probe_status_chip_scaled.js, knob MEDI_STATUS_CHIP_UNSCALED. Shown RED first, reproducing the artifact's own values: showdown 142/146, medicham2 137/146, and the control body (the same Sinistcha carrying Hospitality) agreeing at 137 in both engines.
which_scoreboard: THE LAB AND THE POOL. Heatproof is 56 sheets, so the pool carries exactly one game — expect board-material 36 -> 35. The CENSUS should GAIN a row, because `scalesOwnStatusDamage` is a new tag and the census is built off the tag table: expect live/probed to rise from 829 by however many rows the new tag creates, and missing to stay 0.
why_it_might_miss_HIGH: The one row is `-damage field 3`, a VALUE mismatch on a line both engines emit, so the game does not end there and can re-part on a later cause — the batch-D/E mechanism.
why_it_might_miss_LOW: Heatproof is only two carriers in the format (Sinistcha and Sinistcha-Masterpiece), so a second affected game would have to be a second Sinistcha burn; the pool holds one.
census_caveat: A census that gains rows changes WHICH scenarios all_mechanics_fire plays, so a mechanics count taken either side of this step is not a before/after. The whole-game run is pinned to census-pin-9446a684709d and is NOT affected.
